scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** title, description, or action text wraps at a supported narrow width
- **THEN** content remains visible, the nested control remains operable, and no horizontal overflow is introduced by the component
scenarios.id: application-compositions/card-with-action::Card content remains usable under bounded stress::Long content is rendered in a narrow container
scenarios.name: Long content is rendered in a narrow container
scenarios.requirement: Card content remains usable under bounded stress
scenarios.requirementContent: The composition SHALL offer a fluid modifier that fits its container down to 240 pixels, permits text wrapping, and grows vertically when localized or enlarged content no longer fits the source height.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a consumer renders a native link or button in `.shlz-card-with-action__actions`
- **THEN** that nested control alone owns focus, activation, navigation, and disabled semantics
scenarios.id: application-compositions/card-with-action::Card with action is a narrow presentational composition::Consumer supplies an action
scenarios.name: Consumer supplies an action
scenarios.requirement: Card with action is a narrow presentational composition
scenarios.requirementContent: The styles package SHALL expose a `.shlz-card-with-action` composition with structured title, description, optional decorative visual, and actions regions. The source specimen SHALL be 314 by 230 pixels with a 16-pixel radius and SHALL accept an existing Button or Link as its nested action without making the card root interactive.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the source-size modifier is used
- **THEN** the composition preserves the 314 by 230 source geometry without clipping its structured content contract
scenarios.id: application-compositions/card-with-action::Card with action is a narrow presentational composition::Exact specimen is requested
scenarios.name: Exact specimen is requested
scenarios.requirement: Card with action is a narrow presentational composition
scenarios.requirementContent: The styles package SHALL expose a `.shlz-card-with-action` composition with structured title, description, optional decorative visual, and actions regions. The source specimen SHALL be 314 by 230 pixels with a 16-pixel radius and SHALL accept an existing Button or Link as its nested action without making the card root interactive.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a consumer renders the documented semantic heading and supporting content
- **THEN** the content follows DOM reading order and the root introduces no interaction role
scenarios.id: application-compositions/cover::Cover is a static structured composition::Cover is read by assistive technology
scenarios.name: Cover is read by assistive technology
scenarios.requirement: Cover is a static structured composition
scenarios.requirementContent: The styles package SHALL expose a `.shlz-cover` composition with eyebrow, title, description, and metadata regions. The source-ratio specimen SHALL use an 874 by 400 aspect ratio and a white source surface while retaining real text rather than outlined source paths.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** available width is below the documented source-ratio range
- **THEN** all text remains visible without horizontal overflow and the cover grows in block size
scenarios.id: application-compositions/cover::Cover supports bounded responsive content::Cover is rendered in a narrow container
scenarios.name: Cover is rendered in a narrow container
scenarios.requirementContent: The fluid cover SHALL fit its container down to 320 pixels, wrap structured text, and replace the fixed aspect ratio with content-driven height when the source ratio cannot contain the content.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the card contains only report data
- **THEN** it remains a readable article and does not expose pointer or keyboard activation
scenarios.id: application-compositions/report-card::Report card has no implied activation::No link is supplied
scenarios.name: No link is supplied
scenarios.requirement: Report card has no implied activation
scenarios.requirementContent: The root SHALL remain non-interactive. An optional nested Link MAY be supplied by the consumer and SHALL be the only navigation target.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** structured report content is placed in the documented regions
- **THEN** the value and title remain the primary reading order and decorative trailing geometry is hidden from assistive technology
scenarios.id: application-compositions/report-card::Report card presents a structured report summary::A report summary is rendered
scenarios.name: A report summary is rendered
scenarios.requirement: Report card presents a structured report summary
scenarios.requirementContent: The styles package SHALL expose a `.shlz-report-card` composition with eyebrow, title, value, metadata, and trailing-decoration regions. Its source specimen SHALL be 314 by 230 pixels with a 16-pixel radius and SHALL support the white and `#EEF0F4` muted source surfaces.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** `.shlz-report-card--muted` is applied
- **THEN** the surface uses the source-observed muted paint without changing semantics or inventing state behavior
scenarios.id: application-compositions/report-card::Report card presents a structured report summary::Muted source variant is selected
scenarios.name: Muted source variant is selected
scenarios.requirement: Report card presents a structured report summary
scenarios.requirementContent: The styles package SHALL expose a `.shlz-report-card` composition with eyebrow, title, value, metadata, and trailing-decoration regions. Its source specimen SHALL be 314 by 230 pixels with a 16-pixel radius and SHALL support the white and `#EEF0F4` muted source surfaces.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the fluid modifier is rendered at 240 pixels or with long content
- **THEN** text wraps, the card grows vertically, and content does not overlap the trailing decoration
scenarios.id: application-compositions/report-card::Report card supports bounded content stress::Fluid report content is stressed
scenarios.name: Fluid report content is stressed
scenarios.requirement: Report card supports bounded content stress
scenarios.requirementContent: The fluid report card SHALL fit its container down to 240 pixels, wrap structured text, grow vertically when content needs more height, and reserve the trailing-decoration gutter across lower text regions.
